notes.title: Content Patch #4
notes.notes:
New Stage

Added the homeless Stage and the corresponding slum challenge. The slum will hinder the development of the city, but it can be eliminated
Added Copper badge and Silver badge Achievements in Homeless Stage


Changes
Achievements

Firemen Silver badge: Had a Grow+20 builder after stage 10
Firemen Gold badge: Destroyed 20 Ruins or Large ruins after stage 10
Soldier Silver badge: Had a Grow+30 Soldier after stage 10
Soldier Gold badge: Had 10 Weapons after stage 10

notes.title: Content Patch #3
notes.notes:

Optimization: Activation symbol performance effect
Optimization: hints for symbols to obtain multiples

notes.title: Content Patch #2
notes.notes:
Changes

Optimize the novice guide interface
Optimize the UI position of the Reroll order
Optimize some sound effects

notes.title: Content Patch #1
notes.notes:
Changes

Add a guide when starting the game
Added a link to the Symbols Guide in the main menu interface
The newly generated symbol adds the animation effect of entering the inventory
Driver (Rarity： very rare→ rare)； Repairman (Rarity： rare→very rare)
Some symbols animations have been speed up
Skip the remaining spins increase the defense value additionally, and the increased amount is (the defense value obtained in this spin * the number of remaining spins * 50%)


Bug Fixes

Fixed that the 20 ruins required in the Fireman achievement contained large ruins
Fixed the problem that the avatar icon of the Global ranking interface was reversed
Fixed the problem that the volume of some sound effects could not be adjusted

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes: Hello everyone, dear players! The release of the From Dusk To Dawn game took place.
